# appgatesdp_stats_active_sessions_dashboard (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `geo_ip_data` (Attributes List) Geolocation data related to active sessions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--geo_ip_data))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `total_count` (Number) The total count of active sessions.
- `versions` (Attributes Map) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--geo_ip_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `geo_ip_data`

Read-Only:

- `continent_code` (String) The continent code associated with the geolocation.
- `country_code` (String) The country code associated with the geolocation.
- `ips` (List of String) The IP addresses associated with the sessions in this geolocation.
- `latitude` (Number)
- `longitude` (Number)
- `session_count` (Number) The count of sessions for this geolocation.


<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `session_count` (Number) The count of sessions using this client version.
- `support_status` (String) The support status of the client version.
